capabilities: Visualize tasks as draggable nodes in an interactive graph
Connect tasks with 🆔/⛔ emoji and blockedBy/dependsOn dependency syntax
Filter the graph by multiple tags
Mark tasks done or undone directly from the graph
Treat whole notes as tasks via NoteTask frontmatter
extras: Pre-v1.0 with breaking changes expected to the embed format, filter field names, and settings; full documentation lives on an external site (nicoknl.github.io/tasks-map).
intentEvidence: Required: Dataview and Tasks plugins must be installed and enabled.
problem: Obsidian's graph view shows notes, not tasks, so task dependencies and relationships are invisible in a visual map.

relations.evidence: It supports both inline checkbox tasks (- [ ] task text) via Dataview
Required: Dataview and Tasks plugins must be installed and enabled.

summary: Task graph plugin that renders checkbox and file-based tasks as interactive nodes with dependency edges, tag filtering, and in-graph completion.
